modules.title: Introduction to Data and Information
modules.html:
Data types and the information processing cycle: input, processing, output and storage. This section covers introduction to data and information.

Key points

  • The high-level programming language developed for business data processing is _____. — COBOL.
  • Which memory type must be constantly refreshed to retain data — DRAM.
  • The act of pretending to be a trustworthy entity to steal sensitive information online is called _____. — Phishing.
  • Which component stores data permanently — Hard Disk.
  • Information is: — Processed data.

Worked examples

Q: The high-level programming language developed for business data processing is _____.
A: COBOL — COBOL (Common Business-Oriented Language) was designed specifically for business, finance, and administrative systems.

Q: Which memory type must be constantly refreshed to retain data?
A: DRAM — Dynamic RAM (DRAM) uses capacitors that leak charge and thus must be refreshed periodically.

examples.q: The high-level programming language developed for business data processing is _____.
Which memory type must be constantly refreshed to retain data?

quiz.q: The high-level programming language developed for business data processing is _____.
quiz.solution: COBOL (Common Business-Oriented Language) was designed specifically for business, finance, and administrative systems.

quiz.q: Which memory type must be constantly refreshed to retain data?
quiz.solution: Dynamic RAM (DRAM) uses capacitors that leak charge and thus must be refreshed periodically.

quiz.q: The act of pretending to be a trustworthy entity to steal sensitive information online is called _____.
quiz.solution: Phishing involves sending fraudulent communications (like emails) that appear to come from a reputable source.

quiz.q: Which component stores data permanently?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Hard Disk.

quiz.q: Information is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Processed data.

quiz.q: The process of encoding information so that only authorized parties can read it is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Encryption.

quiz.q: Smallest Data:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Bit.

quiz.q: A website's main page is called the _____.
quiz.solution: The home page is the introductory page of a website, typically serving as a table of contents.

quiz.q: A small image representing a program or file is a/an _____.
quiz.solution: Icons are used in Graphical User Interfaces to represent applications, objects, or functions.

quiz.q: The CPU consists of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: ALU and Control Unit.

quiz.q: Software that protects against viruses is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Antivirus.

quiz.q: Which topology has a central hub?

quiz.q: Hexadecimal base:

quiz.q: The mechanical calculator invented by Blaise Pascal is called the...

quiz.q: The largest network in the world is the...
